description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three models, namely an unnamed model, GPT4o, and Sonnet, under different prompt conditions, specifically basic prompt, structured prompt + oracle, and structured prompt + predicted. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, labeled with the model names, while the vertical axis represents the performance values, ranging from 0 to 0.7 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each model has three bars corresponding to the different prompt conditions, colored blue for basic prompt, orange for structured prompt + oracle, and green for structured prompt + predicted. The blue bars have values around 0.3-0.35, with the exact values being approximately 0.33 for the unnamed model, 0.25 for GPT4o, and 0.35 for Sonnet. The orange bars are significantly taller, with values of approximately 0.6 for the unnamed model, 0.57 for GPT4o, and 0.52 for Sonnet. The green bars have intermediate values, with the unnamed model at around 0.35, GPT4o at approximately 0.45, and Sonnet at around 0.43. The bars are grouped by model, with the three prompt conditions appearing together for each model, and are not sorted in a specific order. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
